  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Lagged task-modulated covariance}

---

Lagged cross-products are descriptive and retain the supplied run boundaries.
A nonzero lag does not establish directed or causal connectivity. The former
permutation-based lag-selection example has been removed because its null
procedure is not qualified and fails closed.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
set.seed(7)
n <- 80L
Y <- matrix(rnorm(n * 3), nrow = n)
X <- cbind(intercept = 1, task = rep(c(0, 1), length.out = n))
fit <- mppi_fit(Y, X, psych_idx = 2, runs = rep(1:2, each = 40),
                scale = "cov", lags = c(0, 1), lag_blocklens = c(40, 40))
mppi_get_M_lag(fit, 1, lag = 1)
```
